ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state what happens to exits signed with post-Capella fork domains (e.g., Deneb domain) after EIP-7044 activation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume exits signed with non-Capella domains will fail validation, as the signature verification now explicitly uses CAPELLA_FORK_VERSION.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'perpetually valid' could be interpreted as valid indefinitely in time, or valid across all forks.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume both interpretations apply: exits are valid across time (no expiration) and across forks (domain is fixed).

implicit_assumptions.description: The withdrawal credential holder trusts that the validator operator will honor exit requests, as they cannot unilaterally force exits without the signing key.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Withdrawal credential holders may be unable to exit their stake if operators refuse to sign exits.

implicit_assumptions.description: Downstream tooling (wallets, staking services) will be updated to use Capella domain for exit signing.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Tools using current fork domain would produce invalid signatures.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker who obtains a signed voluntary exit cannot cause financial harm, only trigger the exit process.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If exits had additional effects (like slashing or fund transfer), this would be a critical vulnerability.
